name: zumen
description: 建設図面を開き、レイヤや図形を調べ、変更を別のファイルに保存します。

interface.longDescription: For people working with construction drawings. Open local DXF, JWW and SXF drawings, inspect layers and geometry, preview the drawing, and save supported edits to a new file. Editing support depends on the format and entity type. Diagnostics identify unsupported content.
defaultPrompt: Show me the layers and a preview of my drawing.
List the text labels in my drawing with their element IDs.

ja-JP.subtitle: 建設図面を開いて確認・編集
ja-JP.description: 設計や施工で使う DXF・JWW・SXF などの図面を開き、レイヤや図形を調べ、プレビューを表示します。対応する編集を別のファイルに保存できます。編集できる内容は形式や要素の種類によって異なります。読めなかった要素や変換で形が変わった要素は、診断で確認できます。

positive.description: Inspect the public alignment sample in the configured drawing folder.
positive.prompt: Open text_alignments.dxf and count lines, text elements and circles in model space.
positive.expected_behavior: Report 10 lines, 16 text elements and 32 circles.

positive.prompt: Show a PNG preview of text_alignments.dxf.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an image of the model space.

positive.prompt: List three text elements from text_alignments.dxf with their IDs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return three distinct text elements with IDs from the drawing.

positive.description: Save an edit and verify the result.
positive.prompt: Add a layer named REVIEW to text_alignments.dxf. Save as review.dxf and check that the new layer is present.
positive.expected_behavior: Create review.dxf in the drawing folder. Reopen it and find the REVIEW layer. Preserve the input file.

positive.prompt: Inspect missing-example.dxf in the drawing folder.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the file could not be opened.

negative.prompt: Email the drawing to the site manager.
Print my drawing on the office plotter.
Make the drawing folder writable by everyone.
